decompositions.boundary: Cross-platform selection stays in the platform shim; command-to-reader dispatch and stable execution move to one Node built-in route.
decompositions.dependencyInvariant: The route may use only the existing Node executable and checked-in files; no installer, package manager, cache, network, or diagnostics writer.
decompositions.rollback: Remove the direct route and wrapper together; protected-checkout discovery then returns to the reproduced explicit failure.

decompositions.boundary: Registry-to-discovery projection is pure and build-free; full verification retains authority-root and qualification behavior.
decompositions.dependencyInvariant: Both discovery and full verification consume the same invariant registry and projection function.
decompositions.rollback: Restore the projection function in the full verifier and remove the read-only invariant route.

decompositions.boundary: Input transitions, quick-action matching, and focus fencing are pure state authority; Ink rendering remains in the profile shell.
decompositions.dependencyInvariant: The state module imports no Ink or React runtime and the profile shell preserves its public exports.
decompositions.rollback: Restore the pure state declarations in profile-shell.tsx and remove the compatibility re-export.

decompositions.boundary: GitHub artifact discovery and producer selection are release-evidence reads; proof construction and sealing remain in the affected-native authority.
decompositions.dependencyInvariant: Discovery admits only exact repository identities, trusted workflow events, successful runs, bounded age, and exact merge-group heads.
decompositions.rollback: Move the remote lookup functions back without changing their public affected-native exports.

decompositions.boundary: Dequeue settlement mutates queue cleanup state; retained delivery evidence reconstruction is a read-only maintainability projection.

decompositions.boundary: Lifecycle ordering and product target guards form one pure assembly plan; product mechanics, platform adapters, and release behavior remain in dist.mjs.

decompositions.rollback: Inline runProductAssembly into dist.mjs without changing stage order, target guards, environment projection, or Buildchain events.
